# Insight2Strategy
> Practical marketing, sales and AI help for small businesses and technology companies. Free step-by-step guides for common growth problems, short diagnostic reports when you want an outside answer, and plans built around your business that your own team can run.

Insight2Strategy (I2S) was founded in 2025 by Joe Morrison. Work is organized around the problems owners describe: the right people don't know you exist, people don't see why they should choose you, interest isn't turning into sales, marketing spend you can't measure, AI that isn't paying off, and getting a new business or offer started. Diagnostic reports take 3 business days and cost $197 to $1,000; plans built around your business start at $3,500.

## How we work

You can do most of this yourself with the free guides. If you'd rather move faster, or you don't have the time or in-house skills, we build the plan with you and hand it off so your own team, or a local or lower-cost team, can run it. Every report cites its sources, states its assumptions, and ends with specific next steps.
